description: Check available signals of a USDT (Tether) freeze. Covers Ethereum, Tron, Avalanche, Celo, Solana and TON. Returns risk level 0–3 (0 no signals found, not a safety guarantee; 1 freeze proposal open; 2 second of three signatures; 3 evidence of a freeze), recommended manual review, per-chain reasons and freshness, USDT balance, open proposals and past episodes. Timing, completeness and future execution are not guaranteed. Use for counterparty due diligence or checking whether an address has freeze signals. Does not authorise or perform asset operations.

address.description: Address: 0x… (Ethereum/Avalanche/Celo), T… (Tron), TON (EQ…/UQ…) or Solana base58.

lang.description: Language of texts in the result. Default: Russian unless the client prefers English.

live.description: Also read status and balance from a node right now (default true). false is faster.

name: check_address
title: Check USDT freeze risk
